envelope.description: Add the team claim and release commands

body.title: Add the team claim and release commands
body.summary: Add claim and release subcommands to the terminal team command dispatcher (runTeam in src/cli/command.ts) taking the unit as an epic hash, an epic hash and story id, or an epic hash, story id and task id, call claim and release through the services layer, and print the outcome or the refusal naming the holder in the same format as the review-block message. Unknown input prints the usage line.
acceptanceChecks: team claim and team release resolve the unit, call the gate functions and print the outcome
Bad or missing arguments print the usage line

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/team-claim-release.test.ts: team claim and team release resolve the unit, call the gate functions, print the outcome or the holder, and print the usage line for bad arguments
